note: Jack County TX does not zone: county Public Works page says it has no zoning requirements. City of Jacksboro (the only city likely to zone) publishes its zoning ordinance as text and district checklists (ecode360, DocumentCenter PDFs); its City Zoning Map page returns 404 and no map polygons or ArcGIS REST zoning layer were found in searches of arcgis and the web. Bryson and other Jack County towns publish no zoning GIS found. Parcel data for Jack County is only paid (Dynamo Spatial, TaxNetUSA).
